preconditions.description: Grid dimensions and number of days are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == w for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row of the grid has the correct width.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in ['.', '#'] for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either '.' or '#'.
Limak's house and school are not blocked.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 10 for k in k_values)
preconditions.description: Number of temporarily blocked cells per day is within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= r <= h and 1 <= c <= w for r, c in blocked_cells)
preconditions.description: Temporarily blocked cells are within grid bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(grid[r-1][c-1] == '.' for r, c in blocked_cells)
preconditions.description: Temporarily blocked cells are not permanently blocked.

postconditions.expression: all(answer in ['YES', 'NO'] for answer in answers)

postconditions.description: The number of answers matches the number of days.

postconditions.expression: all(is_interesting(grid, blocked_cells) == (answer == 'YES') for blocked_cells, answer in zip(blocked_days, answers))
postconditions.description: Each answer correctly indicates whether the day is interesting.
